            }
            
            global::System.Collections.IEnumerator global::System.Collections.IEnumerable.GetEnumerator() => GetEnumerator();
            
            public bool TryFormatMessage(global::System.Span<byte> destination, out int bytesWritten)
            {
                var written = 0;
                if (
                    !global::Pragmatic.Logging.CallSites.Utf8LogFormat.TryAppend(destination, ref written, "Saga "u8)
                    || !global::Pragmatic.Logging.CallSites.Utf8LogFormat.TryAppend(destination, ref written, _sagaType)
                    || !global::Pragmatic.Logging.CallSites.Utf8LogFormat.TryAppend(destination, ref written, " (correlation "u8)
                    || !global::Pragmatic.Logging.CallSites.Utf8LogFormat.TryAppend(destination, ref written, _correlationId)
                    || !global::Pragmatic.Logging.CallSites.Utf8LogFormat.TryAppend(destination, ref written, ") was saved by another writer first; reading it again (attempt "u8)
                    || !global::Pragmatic.Logging.CallSites.Utf8LogFormat.TryAppendFormatted(destination, ref written, _attempt, "")
                    || !global::Pragmatic.Logging.CallSites.Utf8LogFormat.TryAppend(destination, ref written, ")"u8)
                )
                {
                    bytesWritten = 0;
                    return false;
                }
                
                bytesWritten = written;
                return true;
            }
            
            public void WriteProperties(global::System.Text.Json.Utf8JsonWriter writer)
            {
                writer.WriteString(__Name0, _sagaType);
                writer.WriteString(__Name1, _correlationId);
                writer.WriteNumber(__Name2, (int)_attempt);
            }
            
            public bool TryFormatMessage(in __LogSagaConflictRetryingLogState state, global::System.Span<byte> destination, out int bytesWritten)
                => state.TryFormatMessage(destination, out bytesWritten);
            
            public void WriteProperties(in __LogSagaConflictRetryingLogState state, global::System.Text.Json.Utf8JsonWriter writer)
                => state.WriteProperties(writer);
            
            public override string ToString() => global::Pragmatic.Logging.CallSites.Utf8LogFormat.Render(this);
        }
